 Search "The Remarried Empress": 5 Things Fans Want to See Next After the First 4 Episodes
 Disha Paul 14 minutes ago 5 min read With Navier's marriage falling apart and Heinrey entering the picture, The Remarried Empress has given viewers plenty to talk about. Here are five things fans may want to see as the Disney+ K-drama continues. 
 Not every empress gets the chance to rewrite her own love story. But in The Remarried Empress , Navier is not prepared to let a broken marriage decide the rest of her life. 
 After four episodes, K-drama fans have five major things they hope to see unfold in The Remarried Empress . (Disney+) Starring Shin Min-a , Ju Ji-hoon , Lee Jong-suk , and Lee Se-young , the new Korean fantasy romance has already introduced viewers to a palace filled with betrayal, jealousy, complicated relationships, and political tension. 
 Its first four episodes arrived earlier than originally planned, giving fans an early look at Navier's difficult marriage to Emperor Sovieshu and the growing connection between her and Crown Prince Heinrey. 
 With Episodes 5 and 6 approaching, viewers have plenty of questions about what comes next. While the series has only begun exploring its central relationships, here are five developments fans may be hoping to see in the upcoming episodes. 
 1. Navier Finally Choosing Herself 
 One of the most compelling parts of Navier's story is that she does not immediately fall apart when her marriage begins to crumble. 
 As the Empress of the Eastern Empire, she has spent years fulfilling her responsibilities and standing by Sovieshu—however, his decision to bring Rashta into the palace as his mistress changes everything. 
 The Remarried Empress  (Disney+) What makes Navier interesting is her determination to protect her dignity rather than beg for affection. She understands that her marriage is no longer what it once was, but she also refuses to let Sovieshu control every decision about her future. 
 Viewers will likely be looking forward to seeing her take more control of her life. Her decision to request remarriage is already a major turning point, and the upcoming episodes could show just how determined she is to move forward. 
 2. More Romantic Moments Between Navier and Heinrey 
 If there is one relationship that has viewers curious, it is Navier and Heinrey's growing connection. 
 Unlike Sovieshu, Heinrey approaches Navier with a different kind of attention. His interest in her creates an intriguing contrast, especially when she has spent so much time being taken for granted in her own marriage. 
 Their relationship is not simply about finding a replacement for Sovieshu. 
 The Remarried Empress  (Disney+) Navier is a powerful political figure, and Heinrey is the Crown Prince of a rival kingdom. Any relationship between them could have consequences far beyond the palace walls. 
 Fans will want to see whether Heinrey genuinely understands Navier and whether their connection can develop into something deeper. Their chemistry is one of the reasons many viewers are already curious about the next episodes. 
 3. Sovieshu Realising What He Could Lose 
 Sovieshu is an important part of the drama's conflict, and his decisions have already changed Navier's life. 
 His relationship with Rashta has created a situation he may not be able to control as easily as he expects. While he appears determined to pursue his new relationship, Navier's decision to seek another marriage introduces a very different problem. 
 Will Sovieshu finally understand the consequences of treating his wife as someone who will always remain by his side? 
 The upcoming episodes have an opportunity to explore his reaction as Navier begins making decisions without depending on him. His response could also  reveal whether his feelings for her are more complicated than he is willing to admit. 
 4. Rashta's Growing Influence Inside the Palace 
 Rashta is more than just the woman who enters Sovieshu's life and disrupts his marriage. Her position in the palace creates another important layer to the story. 
 Coming from a very different background, she is suddenly surrounded by people who judge her, watch her every move, and question her place beside the Emperor. At the same time, her growing influence could create tension among those who have spent years serving the imperial family. 
 The Remarried Empress  (Disney+) The first four episodes have already shown that her presence affects more than Navier's personal life. Her relationship with Sovieshu also has political and social consequences. 
 Viewers will be interested to see how Rashta handles her new position and whether she can maintain the Emperor's favor as the palace becomes increasingly divided. 
 5. More Palace Politics and the Consequences of Navier's Remarriage 
 Although romance drives much of the story, The Remarried Empress  is not just a love triangle. 
 Navier's position as Empress gives her decisions political importance. Her possible marriage to Heinrey could change the relationship between the Eastern and Western kingdoms, making her personal future a matter of international interest. 
 This is where the drama has an opportunity to become even more exciting. Instead of focusing only on who loves whom, the series can explore how relationships, royal duties, and political ambitions influence one another. 
 Fans will be hoping for more of this side of the story as Navier's future becomes increasingly uncertain. 
 Where and When to Watch The Remarried Empress Episodes 5 and 6 
 For viewers waiting for the next chapter, The Remarried Empress  will return with Episodes 5 and 6 on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 . 
 The series is an exclusive Disney+ release in international markets, while viewers in the United States can also watch it on Hulu. Indian viewers should check the JioHotstar catalogue for the regional listing and availability. 
 Disney has confirmed that two new episodes will arrive every Wednesday until the series finale on November 25 . The streaming platform has not announced a confirmed India-specific release time, so viewers should check their local app for the exact availability. 
 Here is the remaining release schedule: 
 November 11, 2026:  Episodes 5 and 6 
 November 18, 2026:  Episodes 7 and 8 
 November 25, 2026:  Episodes 9 and 10 (finale) 
 The first four episodes were released early on November 3, a day ahead of the original premiere date, as a special thank-you to fans. 
 Are You Team Heinrey or Team Sovieshu? 
 Four episodes have already established the central conflict, but Navier's story is far from over. Whether viewers are waiting for more romance, a confrontation with Sovieshu, or a stronger look at the political consequences of her decision, the next two episodes have plenty to address. 
 And perhaps the biggest question is whether Navier will finally find the happiness and respect she could never receive from her first marriage. 
 Are you rooting for Navier and Heinrey, or do you think Sovieshu still has a chance to redeem himself? Tell us what you want to see in Episodes 5 and 6!
